title: Digit Count in Range
summary: Determine the frequency of a single-digit integer d appearing as a digit within the range from low to high, inclusive.
statement: Determine the frequency of a single-digit integer d appearing as a digit within the range from low to high, inclusive.
constraints: Count digit occurrences in ordinary decimal representations without leading zeros.
hints: Count occurrences from one through n independently at each decimal place.
Split n into higher, current, and lower digits around factor; handle zero by removing leading-zero blocks.
At each place, complete higher cycles contribute fixed blocks and the partial cycle depends only on current/lower.
editorial: At each place, complete higher cycles contribute fixed blocks and the partial cycle depends only on current/lower.

tests.explanation: One appears in 1,10,11,12,13 a total of six times.
